entities.summary: Samuel Augustus Barnett was a Church of England cleric and social reformer who was particularly associated with the establishment of the first university settlement, Toynbee Hall, in east London in 1884. He is often referred to as Canon Barnett, having served as Canon of Westminster Abbey from 1906 until his death. Samuel Augustus Barnett was a religious figures from Bristol (1844-02-08, Bristol–1913-06-17). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
